caution_findings.evidence_context: Local sources provide narrative outcomes and Supplementary Tables S3-S6 statistical comparisons, but not exact Fig. 3/Fig. 4 plotted bar heights or raw replicate values.
GF19 pre-treatment and post-treatment phenotypes support likely viral-entry blocking, but no direct virion-binding/fusion/envelope-disruption assay is present.
The linked APD6 row supports qualitative anti-HSV-1 activity/MOA text but no exact numeric endpoint.
GF19 Table 1 IC50 is an AVP-IC50Pred prediction and must not be normalized as a measured HCEC IC50 value.
